show.description: My Crush, My Kidnapper is a dark romantic thriller about obsession, betrayal, and survival. Sneha, a passionate dancer, dreams of love and success, but her world shatters when a hidden video turns her into the target of blackmail and a dangerous crime syndicate. As her crush Amay tries to protect her, and Rahil’s twisted desire drags her deeper into a deadly trap, Sneha must fight not just for her dreams—but for her life.
